corroborating_sources.name: Cracku (Unacademy) - SSC CGL Tier I 2023 Question Paper Shift 1 (July 14th), solved page
corroborating_sources.note: Independent memory-based reconstruction. All 100 questions align 1:1 with the exam-screen export (question order, section boundaries GI&R 1-25 / GA 26-50 / Quant 51-75 / English 76-100, and content). Used to fill gaps where the exam export's text layer was incomplete (e.g., GI&R Q15 option D, GA Q16 options, Quant Q2/Q5/Q13/Q18/Q19/Q21/Q22, English Q14/Q16/Q18).

corroborating_sources.name: KD Campus - SSC CGL Exam Analysis 2023, 14 July Shift 1
corroborating_sources.note: Independent confirmation that this date+shift was conducted; topic profile consistent with the paper (GA: Nobel prize 1901, Tapi Basin, citizenship articles, steady-state; English: 5-question cloze test, spelling-error questions; Reasoning: 2 syllogisms).

notes: AUTHENTICITY: SSC does not publish CGL Tier I papers. Source A is a capture of the actual CBE exam screen (contains SSC question IDs and one candidate's responses), making it the most faithful available record; source B is an independent faculty reconstruction. The two sources agree on all 100 question slots (order and content); known textual discrepancies between the sources are flagged per-question in answer_note. SECTION ORDER on screen was General Intelligence & Reasoning (Q1-25), General Awareness (Q26-50), Quantitative Aptitude (Q51-75), English Comprehension (Q76-100); global numbering here follows that order. FIGURES: several reasoning/quant items are figure-based; where a figure is not recoverable from the text sources, the question text is preserved as available and the missing figure is marked [figure] (not invented). OCR ARTIFACTS in source A (e.g., 'LaOshya' for 'LaQshya') were resolved using source B where unambiguous; otherwise source A wording is preserved verbatim. ANSWERS: The official SSC answer key for this exam (tentative key uploaded 01-Aug-2023, notice Write_Up_Tentative_AnswerKey_T1_CGLE_2023_01082023; final key with response sheets) is only accessible via candidate login on ssc.gov.in/ssc.nic.in, and coaching faculty solutions are login-gated; no accessible authoritative per-question answer source was available in this environment. Per project answer policy, correct_answer is therefore null for all questions. The candidate's selections in source A are NOT official answers and are recorded in answer_note as reference only (some are plainly wrong, e.g., GA Q46 candidate chose Hubble for the steady-state question; this illustrates why candidate responses are not used as answers).

Human life is (1) _______ a unique blessing, which in turn depends on the (2) _______ of the Self. He who is not aware of the Self can neither have peace nor can he foster peaceful coexistence. We have to link our soul with God and body with the physical world for substance. (3) _______ the formless God is invisible to the naked eye, our mind often wanders wherever it goes. (4) _______ , we are unable to develop any love for the Divine. And religion like the white light of heavens (5) _______ multi-coloured fragmentations by the prisms of men and loses its gravity. Instead of uniting, it becomes a major dividing force. French philosopher Tail hard de Chardin, thinking deeply on meaning of our existence and relationship with the Divine, expounds, 'we are not human beings having a spiritual experience, we are spiritual beings having a human experience'. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
